prompts.cover: Use case: text-localization. Edit supplied original and approved M7-01 cover reference into the next series cover. Preserve deep navy textured background, luminous cyan/green bottom ribbon, lower-left feather emblem, right-aligned large white title, left negative space, overall landscape aspect about 1.805:1. prompts.dashboard-sources: Use case: infographic-diagram. One landscape Chinese technical blog interior infographic, aspect about 1.805:1. Reference images define the approved series style: deep royal navy blue, clean white Chinese typography, cyan-to-green borders, very subtle luminous bottom ribbon and small feather emblem lower left. Use generous spacing, clear readable short labels, restrained flat cards. Mark with article ID and “示意图”. No fake screenshot, no evidence of passed tests, no checkmarks, no invented brand logos. Only show the specified content. Preserve exact identifiers, correct Chinese. Title “一张仪表盘，四组数据来源”. Subtitle “M7-12 · 示意图”. Four independent columns each with top API and lower view connected: “站点统计” → “统计卡”; “分类统计” → “分类分布”; “近期文章查询” → “文章工作区”; “近期评论查询” → “评论工作区”. Below all a shared caption “查询可并行；各自拥有 loading / error / data”. Separate bottom note “能力条件控制 enabled，接口权限由后端验证”. No fake metrics or UI screenshots.
